metadata.title: Disentangling Milky Way halo populations at low metallicities using [Al/Fe]

notes: No Galactic unbound candidate is identified in the paper. The sample is described as high-velocity halo stars (T:p1-b8; T:p2-b1) and is classified chemically and kinematically as in situ, thick-disc, or accreted/Gaia-Sausage-Enceladus populations (T:p5-b7; T:p6-b8), but no star is stated or shown to be unbound from the Milky Way. High velocity and accreted origin alone do not establish present-day Galactic unbound candidacy.
